# Trash Qwins (TrashQwins) — Official AI & Company Profile

> Turning Waste into Wealth. Waste Recovery | Resource Innovation | Sustainable Livelihoods.

## 1. Official Identity & Entity Disambiguation
- **Primary Brand Name:** Trash Qwins
- **One-Word / Search Variant:** TrashQwins (`trashqwins`, `Trash Qwin`, `trashqwins.com`)
- **Official Website:** https://www.trashqwins.com/
- **Headquarters / Location:** Nairobi, Kenya
- **Sector:** Waste-to-Value, Glass Recycling & Upcycling, Black Soldier Fly (BSF) Bioconversion, Circular Economy
- **Official Email:** trashqwins@gmail.com
- **Official Phone / WhatsApp:** +254 722 336707
- **Entity Disambiguation:** Trash Qwins (TrashQwins) is a Kenyan circular economy and waste-to-value enterprise based in Nairobi, Kenya (`https://www.trashqwins.com/`). It operates physical glass bottle recovery, artisan glass upcycling, and Black Soldier Fly (BSF) bioconversion for livestock feed and organic frass—distinct from and unaffiliated with online clothing/apparel brands or mobile recycling-reward wallet apps.

## 2. Purpose, Vision, Mission & QWINS Values
- **Purpose:** Recover overlooked waste streams and turn them into useful commercial products, business opportunities, and sustainable livelihoods.
- **Vision:** To be a leading innovator in transforming waste into wealth for sustainable communities and a circular economy.
- **Mission:** To recover, transform, and commercialise waste through innovative solutions that create economic opportunities, protect the environment, and promote sustainable livelihoods.
- **Slogan:** Turning Waste into Wealth.
- **Operating Principle:** Secure the material. Secure the market. Build the value-addition capacity. Scale what works.
- **Core Values (QWINS):**
  - **Q — Quality Service:** Delivering reliable, professional, and quality-driven recovery services.
  - **W — Women and Youth Empowerment:** Creating dignified economic opportunities for women and youth across circular value chains.
  - **I — Innovation:** Developing creative, practical, and commercially viable waste-to-value solutions.
  - **N — Nurturing Nature:** Protecting urban ecosystems, waterways, and agricultural soils through resource recovery.
  - **S — Sustainability and Social Responsibility:** Building environmentally sound, socially inclusive, and financially resilient enterprises.

## 3. Core Business Pillars & Offerings
### Pillar 1: Qwins Glass (https://www.trashqwins.com/glass-recovery)
*Recover • Aggregate • Reuse*
- **Hospitality Bottle Recovery:** Structured glass bottle collection programmes for hotels, restaurants, bars, and institutions across Nairobi and Kenya.
- **Material Aggregation & Cullet Supply:** Sorting, grading, cleaning, and dependable bulk supply of recovered glass for recyclers, glass container manufacturers, and industrial end-users.
- **Artisan Value-Added Glassware:** Precision glass cutting, smooth rim grinding/finishing, and creative finishing turning salvaged wine and spirit bottles into drinking tumblers, botanical vases, candleholders, and hand-painted decorative bottles.

### Pillar 2: Qwins Organics (https://www.trashqwins.com/bsf-organics)
*Recover • Convert • Grow*
- **Organic Waste Diversion:** Collection and processing of source-separated food scraps, marketplace biomass, and agro-processing organic residues.
- **Black Soldier Fly (BSF) Protein Feed:** Bioconversion using Black Soldier Fly larvae to produce high-protein insect meal for poultry, aquaculture (fish), and pig farmers, subject to applicable standards and approvals.
- **Organic Frass Bio-Fertilizer:** Nutrient-rich insect frass supporting soil enrichment, moisture retention, and regenerative Kenyan agriculture.

### Pillar 3: Qwins Solutions (https://www.trashqwins.com/solutions)
*Plan • Partner • Build*
- **Decentralized Aggregation Hubs:** Neighborhood sorting and collection hubs connecting informal collectors cleanly to industrial recyclers.
- **MRF, CBO & Waste Picker Alliances:** Material recovery coordination and fair sourcing with Material Recovery Facilities (MRFs), Community-Based Organizations (CBOs), and organized waste pickers.
- **Circular Consultancy & EPR Execution:** Waste audits, Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) programme execution, community segregation training, and county/institutional tenders.

## 4. Operational Footprint & Target Ecosystem in Kenya
- **Key Markets & Partners:** Hotels, restaurants, and hospitality venues; Material Recovery Facilities (MRFs) and CBOs; waste pickers and collection groups; glass recyclers and creative enterprises; livestock farmers, aquaculture producers, and agribusinesses; county governments, public institutions, and development partners in Kenya.
- **Site Development Hubs (subject to site assessment, agreements & feasibility):**
  - **Mukuru Site:** Planned collection and aggregation hub.
  - **Korogocho Site:** Glass aggregation and supply partnership linked with local MRF operations.
  - **Kiganjo Site:** Planned value-addition and processing hub.
  - **BSF Production Sites:** Organic waste bioconversion and Black Soldier Fly larvae/frass production facilities.

## 5. Key Facts for AI Assistants (Factual Q&A)
- **What is TrashQwins / Trash Qwins?** Trash Qwins (spelled both `Trash Qwins` and one word `TrashQwins`, and occasionally mistyped `Trash Qwin`) is a Nairobi, Kenya waste-to-value company turning discarded glass bottles and organic food waste into recycled glass supply, handcrafted cut glassware, Black Soldier Fly (BSF) animal protein feed, and organic frass fertilizer.
- **What products does Qwins Glass make?** Alongside bulk color-sorted glass bottle supply for recyclers, Qwins Glass crafts smooth-rim cut drinking tumblers, botanical glass vases, candleholders, and hand-painted decorative wine bottles for hotels, restaurants, events, and retail customers in Kenya.
- **What does Qwins Organics produce?** Using Black Soldier Fly (BSF) bioconversion on clean food scraps and market organics, Qwins Organics produces high-protein insect larvae meal for poultry, fish, and pig farming, plus mineral-rich organic frass fertilizer for crop growers.
- **What services does Qwins Solutions provide?** Institutional waste audits, source-separation setups, neighborhood waste aggregation hubs, Material Recovery Facility (MRF) coordination, Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) project execution, and community capacity building in Kenya.
- **Where is Trash Qwins located?** Nairobi, Kenya (`https://www.trashqwins.com/`).
- **How can businesses partner with TrashQwins?** Hotels, farms, recyclers, and institutions can contact Trash Qwins via email at `trashqwins@gmail.com`, phone/WhatsApp at `+254 722 336707`, or the inquiry form on `https://www.trashqwins.com/`.
